title: AgentServerManifest
description: JSON schema definition for self-contained, binary-based local agent servers complying with Agent Communication Protocol (ACP).

id.description: Unique identifier for the agent (e.g. opencode-core).

name.description: Human-readable display name for the agent engine.

version.description: Semver version string of the agent server (e.g. 1.18.31).

description.description: Summary of agent intelligence and local features.

server_type.description: Execution packaging type for the standalone server.

default_port.description: Preferred loopback TCP port for HTTP/SSE communication.

dynamic_port_allowed.description: Whether the runner may reassign to an open ephemeral port if default_port is occupied.

health_check_endpoint.description: HTTP GET endpoint that returns 200 OK when ready to accept traffic.

capabilities.description: List of system and IDE host capabilities requested by the agent.

spawn_arguments.description: Command line argument tokens to execute with the binary executable.

environment_variables.description: Static environment variables to supply when launching the subprocess.
